snippet.title: REPLACED | OFFICIAL DATE REVEAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
This is it.
The journey is only a heartbeat away. REPLACED is officially releasing on March 12th, 2026 on PC and Xbox!

A future rebuilt. A fate rewritten. Are you ready? #REPLACED #replacedgame
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dive into the world of REPLACED with the Official Release Date Reveal Trailer - a cinematic glimpse into the atmospheric, dystopian future of Phoenix-City, where every frame is hand-crafted in stunning 2.5D pixel art.
Follow R.E.A.C.H., an AI trapped in a human body, as the mystery deepens and choices grow heavier.  Your future begins now.

Wishlist REPLACED:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1663850/REPLACED/
